name: willnet-landing
description: Landing de WillNet: servicios de páginas web. HTML + JavaScript + Tailwind CSS.
author: Willder Gomez (Willdev) <willdevgo@gmail.com>

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run dist && wrangler deploy
scripts.dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/css && cp -R index.html js assets dist/ && cp css/styles.css dist/css/ && find dist \( -name '*.md' -o -name '.DS_Store' \) -delete
